summary: FR-3 fix is correct and improves behavior. The breaking change (awaited tx rejects on inner failure) is properly handled by the production caller (articleController.ts catches and rethrows). The test UI caller (article-test-genarate.tsx) has a pre-existing gap (no .catch()) but this is not introduced by this fix. MCQ filtering replaces silent data corruption (correctAnswer: 0) with a warned skip. Tests are meaningful and assert observable contract behavior.

The production caller (articleController.ts) handles errors correctly.
